title: Ayurveda’s Protein-Rich Plants: Ancient Indian Foods That Can Rival Meat in Protein
description: Green gram, black gram, chickpea, horse gram, lentil, pigeon pea, moth bean, sesame, flax and several other traditional foods appear throughout India's Ayurvedic dietary culture. Modern nutritional science now reveals something remarkable about many of them: when measured in their dry state, several contain around one-fifth to more than one-quarter of their weight as protein. title: England’s Ancient Supervolcano: A 454-Million-Year-Old Giant Hidden Under The Wash
description: Scientists have identified a massive extinct supervolcano beneath The Wash in eastern England. It erupted 454 million years ago with force equivalent to thousands of hydrogen bombs, spreading ash across northern Europe. Zircon crystal analysis of old borehole samples provided the proof. The find rewrites parts of the region's geological story.
